name: MC Group Public Company Limited
summary: MC Group Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution management of clothing and accessories in Thailand. The company offers a range of products, including apparel products, hats, bags, shoes, etc. under the Mc trademark. It distributes products and services through storefront branches and distribution points, as well as through its website. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
